metadata.sysdescription: A moderatly developed system Krisenda suffers from beeing near the regional capital of Atlantis. That said its a nicde shorcut to the Long Bar Region and is less monitored by autoritys then Atlantis. Smuggling thorough this system is rife and the odd pirate is to be found here.
